scope: unpublished source-controlled review; no live affiliation or offer activation

claims.claim: Original 1990 experimental series observed impaired recognition after some verbal face descriptions
claims.decision: Use only with controlled-task context

claims.claim: Verbal description always impairs face recognition
claims.decision: Reject absolute

claims.claim: 2001 meta analysis: 29 comparisons, N=2018, small negative effect Fisher Zr -0.12
claims.decision: Use as reported, note moderators and heterogeneity

claims.claim: 2014 preregistered replication: 4% immediate and 16% delayed reductions in robber selection
claims.decision: State specific timing; not real-case error probabilities

claims.claim: Descriptions of eyes/mouth led to no significant overshadowing in either tested 2014 study
claims.decision: Do not extrapolate to all lineups

claims.claim: Later model suggests changes in culprit-presence detection and guessing-based selection
claims.decision: Model-based inference only

claims.claim: Puységur archival patient testimony establishes animal magnetism mechanism
claims.decision: Historical record of assertions is not mechanism validation

claims.claim: Zen12 publicly describes 12-minute sessions, a twelve-level system and four listening styles
claims.decision: Attribute to seller, exact SKU verify

claims.claim: Zen12 public catalog Beginner/Premium/Advanced descriptions identify different level sets
claims.decision: Describe general differences; no referred-SKU inference

claims.claim: Separate Zen12 /secret promotional surface advertises full course and bundle
claims.decision: Do not assume same checkout/SKU or price

claims.claim: 12 minutes of Zen12 has same measured outcome as one hour of meditation
claims.decision: Exclude from positive copy

claims.claim: Zen12 proves automatic brainwave entrainment for all listeners
claims.decision: Exclude

claims.claim: 2023 review of 14 binaural beat EEG studies found inconsistent outcomes, high methodological heterogeneity
claims.decision: Literature not retail Zen12 trial

claims.claim: Zen12 public catalog advertises one-year money-back
claims.decision: Referred checkout terms not independently verified

claims.claim: Any current Zen12 price or promo coupon applies to FV referrals
claims.decision: No prices or codes in draft

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live Total Focus publicly advertises satisfaction refund within 14 days
claims.decision: Do not import into Zen12; exact checkout verify

claims.claim: Brainwave Shots Focus Shot publicly describes 15- and 30-minute MP3 versions
claims.decision: No automatic focus improvement inference

claims.claim: Focus Shot immediately improves concentration for hours
claims.decision: Exclude

claims.claim: Existing FV Fieldbook offers a free 52-page focus workbook through existing Dispatch signup
claims.decision: No second form/list, no paid SKU assumption

claims.claim: Final Vestige named Inspire3 publisher acceptance and authorized earning link
claims.decision: Commercial HOLD until account proof

claims.claim: FTC expects clear conspicuous commission disclosure near earning recommendation/link
claims.decision: Include nearby plain language if activated

claims.claim: Product-specific health/efficacy benefit claims require suitable substantiation
claims.decision: Unsupported claims barred

claims.claim: Clicks or leads constitute confirmed paid affiliate commissions
claims.decision: Only independent merchant settlement can confirm

claims.claim: An offline test fixture with paid order represents actual FV revenue
claims.decision: Synthetic fixtures never production data
